how: We read the website of every Las Vegas wedding DJ listed on Lazo (43 listings, 34 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: chapels and venues listed under DJs, a national franchise landing page, out-of-state DJs with a Las Vegas listing, and catering companies. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will DJ my wedding, and can I talk to that person before I sign?
How do you handle the ceremony audio, the toasts and the venue's sound limits, especially at an outdoor site?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booth, a name-in-lights monogram and extra hours on top?

picks.name: Knight Sounds Entertainment
picks.blurb: Knight Sounds has done Las Vegas wedding DJ and entertainment since 1986, with packages from $995 that can add photo booth, lighting and special effects. The site introduces the people behind the music, from the owner handling scheduling and client care to the creative lead preparing each DJ.

picks.name: Music In Motion Events and Photobooths
picks.blurb: Founder DJ Marc P is from Brooklyn, attended LaGuardia High School for the performing arts, and has been DJing since 1993. Music In Motion brings a licensed and insured team, intelligent lighting with custom colors and moving lights, and photobooths out of North Las Vegas.

picks.name: Dynamixx Entertainment/DJ Dynamixx
picks.blurb: A veteran-owned Las Vegas company that owns its own production gear and fields more than 30 DJs matched to the event. Dynamixx covers sound, lighting, DJs, MCs and dancers, and promises they play what you want to hear, not what they want to play.

picks.name: Booker Entertainment
picks.blurb: Booker Entertainment pairs mobile DJ service, with sound and lighting included, and digital photo booth rental for weddings and corporate events across the Las Vegas Valley. Playlist crafting starts the moment you book, and the site walks through its process step by step.

picks.name: Mix Music LV
picks.blurb: Mix Music LV is a DJ and talent collective with a roster of DJs, vocalists and dancers plus its own sound and lighting, building hybrid live-and-DJ experiences for weddings, galas and parties in Las Vegas.

picks.name: Las Vegas DJs & Entertainment productions
picks.blurb: Las Vegas DJs & Entertainment Productions, based in Henderson's Green Valley, offers wedding DJ service with LED lighting, video presentations and a photo booth with attendant, props and unlimited prints. Your names and date can be projected in lights on the dance floor or wall.

picks.name: K-LAB DJ SERVICE
picks.blurb: K-LAB Worldwide lays out wedding DJ packages and convention packages on one page, with sound equipment and setup included and a custom quote option, all starting from a single booking form. Based in Las Vegas with travel available for select bookings.

picks.name: SPTLGHT Entertainment
picks.blurb: SPTLGHT Entertainment is a licensed and insured creative collective of DJs, cover bands, photographers and videographers that also does sound, lighting and event management. Headquartered in Las Vegas with contractors nationwide, it takes one-off wedding bookings as well as agency contracts.

picks.name: Sounds By Lio
picks.blurb: Sounds By Lio is Lionel 'Lio' Miranda's licensed DJ agency, music school and recording studio in the Downtown Arts District. For bookings the team specializes in weddings, parties and clubs, with sound and lighting rentals from the same shop.

picks.name: Twist & Shout Mobile Sound
picks.blurb: Twist and Shout Mobile Sound is Bill Tobler, who styles himself your Director of Wedding Entertainment, DJ and experienced emcee. A one-person Boulder City operation serving Las Vegas, Henderson and Boulder City weddings, with the tagline music when it matters most.
